summary: We are looking for a Frontend Engineer who can build modern, high-performance web and mobile applications using Next.js, React, or React Native and Expo.
responsibilities: Build and maintain web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS
Develop mobile applications using React Native and Expo
Convert Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive UI components
Integrate frontend applications with REST APIs
Optimize applications for performance, SEO, and accessibility
Manage application state and client-side data flow
Write clean, reusable, and well-documented frontend code
Debug UI issues and improve existing user interfaces
required_skills: Strong experience with React and Next.js
Experience building mobile apps using React Native and Expo
Good understanding of responsive design and mobile-first principles
Familiarity with modern frontend tooling and Git workflows
benefits: Opportunity to work on real-world, high-impact products
Ownership of frontend features from design to production
